# Callouts: Flash backup 7.2 - U15 for the clip, TP33 for the reset hold

Source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~97 px/mm in this crop)  
Annotated image: [images/annotated/fb7-2_cooker-u15-tp33.jpg](../../../images/annotated/fb7-2_cooker-u15-tp33.jpg)

The clip goes on U15 with its pin-1 lead on pin 1 (the two dots): leads on 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6 only. The CC3220 is held in reset at TP33, never at R321's right pad, which is the 3.3 V rail.

| # | Ref | Identification | Part / marking | Category | Confidence | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| 3 | U15.3 | U15 pin 3, WP#: no lead |  | Memory | likely | Write protect, only guards the status register (XM25QH64A datasheet p. 5). The clip contacts it, but its lead stays unconnected. |
